name: Delicate Touch
source:
Help Delicacy, a girl who has fallen and needs her wings mended. However, there are wounds that are deeper than physical.

[From [url=https://thisonesthemoon.itch.io/delicate-touch]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帮助坠落凡尘的少女“纤柔”修补双翼吧。然而，有些伤痕远比肉体上的创伤更加深重。

[摘自[url=https://thisonesthemoon.itch.io/delicate-touch]itch.io[/url]]
